integrity: Unrestricted proof is analytical via orthonormal Walsh characters, Vandermonde rank, 2x2 spectral formula and an exact determinant derivative. Finite tests supplement the proof. No independent scientific audit is represented.
scientific_limitations: Coordinate faces and normalized hypercube heat dynamics only; two-frame optimality is for determinant, not minimum singular value or arbitrary sensor placements. Unindexed equivalent calculations are a residual priority risk. Numerical regression tests are not independent proof.
title: Exact heat-sampling ranks of Boolean-cube faces and the sharp two-snapshot horizon
